integrity: Complete 2048-cycle certificate and a standalone Python 3 verifier are embedded; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact computational finite classification of binary de Bruijn cycles of order five only; no general-order assertion. Maximum positive (not absolute) cyclic correlation is equivalent to minimum Hamming shift distance. The 2011 literature reports related worst cases and absolute-sidelobe subsets; full numerical priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed work.
title: Complete order-five de Bruijn cyclic shift-distance distribution
